title: 第21章 内奸身份第22章 真员外
content_zh:
李廷的话犹如一道惊雷，使得屋内的所有人，全都面露骇色。
尤其是宋明远，他的眼神里带着惊疑，带着难以置信，还有一种……深深的恐惧！
不良人最擅长就是收集情报，张员外养有外室且多次前往，这种事情不良人不可能不知道，可档案里面却没有相关记载，这本就是一件离奇的事情。
唯一的可能，就是张员外的这份档案被人掉包了，这说明有人在故意抹去其中的重要信息。
案牍库的档案被人掉包，这说明什么？
不良人中也有人参与了这个案子，而且这个人的身份，绝对不低！
能够自由出入府衙的案牍库，修改或许调换档案卷宗而不引起任何人的怀疑，只有副统领以上的级别，才能做到。
哪怕是宋明远这样的银牌，想要进入案牍库，也要向上级申请，得到许可，才能进入其中查询相关的卷宗。
如果真是这样，那这件案子的背后，不仅仅是裴大将军。
还有不良人！
牵扯太大了！
宋明远也想不到，明明只是一件杀人案，可随着查下去，牵扯的人却越来越多。
单单一个裴大将军已经足够让人心惊胆战，望而却步，现在又多了不良人的高层……
这不是说不良人副统领级别以上的人就比裴将军更可怕，而是他们本来就是不良人啊！
大家平时都在一个府衙里，如果不良人中真的有人参与了这个案子，那他们在做什么，调查什么，对方很可能一清二楚。
试想一下，在你一门心思想着如何揪出幕后黑手时，对方就站在你的面前，用慈眉善目的语气鼓励着你，可眼神深处却隐藏着阴冷和杀意，如同一条藏在家中的毒蛇……
这还怎么玩？！
宋明远脸色有些发白：“不行，这事咱们必须向萧大人汇报。”
事情太大了，这不是他一个小小的银牌所能当得起的。
李廷也有些担心：“我们不能再查下去了，再查下去，我怕我们会死于非命的。”

作为一位老不良人，他深知同行的可怕。
就连姜峰，心中也忽然蹦出上辈子经常在嘴里念叨的一句话：老板，我想辞职不干……
玛德，刚来不良人才几天啊，就碰到这么操蛋的事情？
这时，姜峰又想起了一个细节。
昨夜，黑衣人闯入府衙，救走了梅老二，恰好苏统领不在府衙，那么，对方是如何知道，苏统领刚好不在府衙呢？
另外，想要来不良人大牢救人，可不是有点实力就行了，还要对府衙的布局，巡防等等了如指掌，才能做到这一步。
答应已经很明显了。
有人将府衙的情报泄露给裴将军的人，所以他们救人的行动，才会那么顺利。
“不好！”
姜峰忽然想到了什么，他连忙对着宋明远说道：“头儿，快去大牢！”
宋明远只是愣了片刻，便立马明白了姜峰的意思。
裴将军冒险救人，可如今人又被他们抓回来了，那对方为了掩盖真相，绝对不会再心慈手软。
最好的办法，就是杀了梅老二！
果不其然，等他们来到府衙的大牢，发现梅老二早就断了气。
仵作验尸的结果是因为伤势过重而断气。
张彪和姜峰也参与了整个验尸过程，得出了同样的答案。
可作为得知真相的宋明远等人，心中却很清楚，那是有人来大牢下手了。
于是，宋明远偷偷找大牢的衙役，询问了有谁来过大牢，得到了一个答案。
……
content_en:
Li Ting's words were like a thunder, making everyone in the room look horrified.
Especially Song Mingyuan, his eyes were full of surprise, disbelief, and... deep fear!
The best thing a bad person is good at is gathering intelligence. Zhang Yuan has a foreign wife and has gone there many times. It is impossible for a bad person not to know about this kind of thing, but there is no relevant record in the file. This is a bizarre thing.
The only possibility is that Zhang Yuanwai's file was slipped by someone, which shows that someone is deliberately erasing important information in it.
The files in the archives have been stolen. What does this mean?
There is also someone among the bad guys involved in this case, and this person’s status is definitely not low!
The ability to freely enter and exit the government office's archives, modify or exchange files without arousing anyone's suspicion, can only be achieved by those at the level of deputy commander or above.
Even if someone with a silver medal like Song Mingyuan wants to enter the case file library, he must apply to his superiors and get permission before he can enter it to search for relevant files.
If this is the case, then it is not just General Pei who is behind this case.
There are bad people!
It’s too much involved!
Song Mingyuan never expected that it was just a murder case, but as the investigation continued, more and more people were involved.
General Pei alone is enough to frighten and scare people away, but now there are high-level villains...
This is not to say that people above the deputy commander level are more terrifying than General Pei, but they are bad people to begin with!
Everyone is usually in the same government office. If any of the bad guys are really involved in this case, the other party will probably know exactly what they are doing and what they are investigating.
Just imagine, when you are thinking about how to find out the mastermind behind the scenes, the other person is standing in front of you, encouraging you with a kind and kind tone, but deep in his eyes there is coldness and murderous intent, like a poisonous snake hiding at home...
How to play this? !
Song Mingyuan's face turned pale: "No, we must report this matter to Mr. Xiao."
The matter was too big, and it was beyond what his small silver medal could afford.
Li Ting was also a little worried: "We can't continue the investigation. If we continue the investigation, I'm afraid we will die violently."
As an old delinquent, he is well aware of the horror of his peers.
Even Jiang Feng suddenly thought of a sentence that he often muttered in his previous life: Boss, I want to resign...
Mud, it’s only been a few days since you’ve been here as a delinquent, and you’ve encountered such a fucked-up thing?
At this time, Jiang Feng remembered another detail.
Last night, the men in black broke into the government office and rescued Mei Laoer. Commander Su happened to be not in the government office. So, how did the other party know that Commander Su happened to be not in the government office?
In addition, if you want to come to the Delinquent Prison to rescue people, you don't just have to have some strength. You also need to know the layout of the government office, patrols, etc. to be able to do this.
The promise was obvious.
Someone leaked the government information to General Pei's people, so their rescue operation went so smoothly.
"Not good!"
Jiang Feng suddenly thought of something, and he quickly said to Song Mingyuan: "Boss, go to the prison quickly!"
Song Mingyuan was stunned for a moment and then immediately understood what Jiang Feng meant.
General Pei took a risk to save people, but now that they have captured him again, the other party will never be merciful in order to cover up the truth.
The best way is to kill Mei Laoer!
Sure enough, when they arrived at the government prison, they found that Mei Laoer had already died.
The result of the autopsy was that he died due to excessive injuries.
Zhang Biao and Jiang Feng also participated in the entire autopsy process and came to the same answer.
But Song Mingyuan and others who knew the truth knew very well that someone came to the prison to take action.
So Song Mingyuan secretly went to the yamen of Dalao and asked who had been to Dalao, and got aAnswer.
